programme.title: Hotdishes
programme.desc: You say hotdishes, Frankie says casserole. Either way, these one-pot hotdishes are an affordable way to feed a group of people, or the family for dinner. Plus they're great to freeze for future meals!

programme.title: Frankie & Flour
programme.desc: Flour has the super power to transform into an endless variety of meals. Frankie teaches us how to make three different meals using flour as the affordable vehicle. Save money and strap on an apron. It's time to get messy in the kitchen.

programme.title: Plant-Based Budget Meals
programme.desc: Frankie busts the myth that eating plant-based is expensive. Preparing these good-for-you meals is all about eating seasonally and shopping the bulk aisle to save money on produce. It’s nutritious and great for the planet. Win-win!

programme.title: Date Night
programme.desc: Date night doesn’t have to be at an over-priced, mediocre restaurant. Frankie prepares an affordable and delicious sushi date night at home, plus tips on how to set date night ambiance at home on a struggle budget. That special someone will love it!

programme.title: Lunches for Work
programme.desc: A big way to save money is to prepare homemade lunches for work. Frankie shows us how to make five delicious lunches for the whole work week. You'll be saving money, and you might even be more productive at work after a nutritious homemade lunch!

programme.title: The Weekly Struggle Budget
programme.desc: Frankie figured out the weekly budget grocery equation so you don’t have to. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner for seven days, for a family of four, for under $150. All it takes is a little planning, meal prep, and using up leftovers in inventive ways.

programme.title: An Eggplant Extravaganza
programme.desc: Eggplant: A fruit you didn’t know was a fruit. Often underrated and overlooked, Frankie shows us how to shop for and cook this filling, delicious, cost-effective, and versatile ingredient. The days of mushy, bitter eggplant will be long gone.

programme.title: Cauliflower's Star Power
programme.desc: Cauliflower is a star and can be transformed into unexpected dishes. Plus it's delicious and nutritious! Frankie reminds us to buy dried-goods in bulk and makes a big chuck roast that stretches over three dishes.

programme.title: Food Back from the Dead
programme.desc: Stale bread, old bananas, canned food, dry foods... they've all gotten a bad wrap, but this is not the end of them yet! Don't let this stuff sit in the pantry, don't let it go to waste - Frankie encourages you to stretch further and cheaper!

programme.title: Wrap it Up!
programme.desc: First, Frankie packs a one-two punch of bargain and nutrition with butternut squash in three nostalgic, old school dishes. Then he shows you how to prep portable wraps at home for easy, peasey lunches.

programme.title: Save Dough, Make Dough
programme.desc: Prepping meals at home is cheaper and way more nutritious! Frankie makes portable breakfasts for the work week and forays into the stuffed dough of different cultures.

programme.title: Traveling for Your Tastebuds
programme.desc: You don't have to travel half way around the world to try a different cuisine - Italian and Filipino foods are accessible right here, right now.

programme.title: Instant Gratification
programme.desc: Everyone loves carbs! Endlessly versatile, cheap, and super filling - Frankie shows you tricks for pasta, pizza dough, and delicious, easy ramen meals that aren't soup.

programme.title: Spring Fling
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to cook with mother nature, spring-style. It’s tasty, seasonably affordable, and pretty to look at. It’s time to spring into action with these delicious meals that are light on your plate and your wallet.

programme.title: Cheesin'
programme.desc: Cheese can be really expensive. Frankie teaches us how to cook with more affordable cheese swaps, and we learn how to stretch cheese in a dish so it can be the star without breaking the bank. Bonus: Frankie teaches how to make cheese at home!

programme.title: Fantastic Pastry Presents

programme.title: Bakes On A Budget

programme.title: Bakes Around The World

programme.title: Hack Your Holidays

programme.title: Unique Eats
programme.desc: From a chef making Italian pasta with Mexican flavors to a groundbreaking functional cocktail bar to a couple that roasts whole goats behind a tire shop, Stephanie Izard finds unique eateries serving up one-of-a-kind food.

programme.desc: From roast chicken to smash burgers to hot sauce, Stephanie Izard meets three different chefs putting their own California-inspired spin on food from their heritage by remixing traditional recipes that center local, fresh ingredients.

programme.title: Farm Forward Cooking
programme.desc: From a chef creating dishes that combine her Mexican and Indigenous heritage to a pizza pop up that improvs with farmers market ingredients to a backyard-run Indigenous dinner series, Stephanie Izard meets cooks taking their lead from the land.

programme.title: Family Style
programme.desc: From brothers selling mom’s Syrian food to a Filipino family remixing a classic dessert to a mom and son running an Indian restaurant out of their house, Stephanie meets multi-gen families turning family recipes into smash hit food business.

programme.title: Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Latin-inspired ice cream to Caribbean, Channa curry doubles to gourmet, deli sandwiches; Stephanie Izard shows what comfort food means to 3 very different cooks and learns how they turned their childhood memories into thriving food businesses.

programme.title: Say Cheese
programme.desc: There’s no such thing as too much cheese, especially for these creators as they attempt record-setting cheese pulls and unique spins on the sensational feta pasta. Whose culinary creation will melt the internet?!

programme.title: Can You Hack It
programme.desc: Competitors push the creative limits of the well-known wrap hack, then aim to impress the judges by elevating another internet favorite in pasta pies. You may know these viral hacks well, but you’ve never seen them done quite like this.

programme.title: Holiday
programme.desc: The creators show off their best holiday handiwork in the kitchen, cranking out seasonal stuffed waffles and hot chocolate bomb-inspired desserts to celebrate the most wonderful time of the year.

programme.title: Snack Attack
programme.desc: The creators are challenged to shrink the internet’s favorite grubby meals down to miniature perfection and blow them up to gargantuan greatness. But size isn’t the only thing that matters to the judges, they’re looking for flawless flavor.

programme.title: Summer Fun
programme.desc: As summer heats up, the creators sweat it out in the kitchen putting an original spin on corn ribs and a transforming watermelon into a savory dish. Who will whip up this year’s hottest recipe?

programme.title: Dish in Disguise
programme.desc: The internet falls fast for snacks and hacks that look like one thing but taste like another. Creators must make "donuts" with anything but traditional batter, then flip the script on ramen, using it in an unconventional yet recognizable way.

programme.title: Make It or Bake It
programme.desc: Baking videos send our social media feeds in a frenzy and we can’t seem to get enough. Watch as creators impress the judges with a show stopping focaccia, then pay tribute to the mini pancake cereal trend by concocting their own unique cereal.

programme.title: Chicken or the Egg
programme.desc: No matter which came first, neither one is leaving the internet anytime soon. Creators aim to reinvent two iconic viral recipes, starting with a jazzed up egg sandwich sensation, and then their most innovative bucket of fried chicken.

programme.title: Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Latin-inspired ice cream to Caribbean, Channa curry doubles to gourmet, deli sandwiches; Stephanie Izard shows what comfort food means to 3 very different cooks and learns how they turned their childhood memories into thriving food businesses.

programme.title: Apocalypse Burgers
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks the summer off right with a burger blowout featuring Brisket Burgers with Grilled Onions and Blue Cheese, Shrimp Burgers with XO Sauce and a Fried Egg, and Lamb Sliders with Feta Ranch and don’t forget the Lemon Oregano Fries.

programme.title: Summer Surf 'n' Turf
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks lobster & steak to the curb as he puts a Spanish-style spin on your typical surf ‘n’ turf by creating Pork & Clams, Lobster and Mushroom Fideos, and Tomato & Tuna Bread then washing it all down with a tasty Michelada.

programme.title: Grill These Sandwiches
programme.desc: Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

programme.title: Summer Seafood Smorgasbord
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde gets his beach vibes going with a grilled shrimp & lobster cocktail, clams with lemon breadcrumbs, a killer grilled king crab with burnt citrus butter, and a chilled mango frozen daiquiri. Don’t you dare miss this beach party!

programme.title: Feast of Killer Crab & Perfect Pork Belly
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde prepares a finger food feast with char grilled chili crab, spiced adobo potatoes, grilled pork belly, & sofrito stuffed branzino all served on a bed of rice over banana leaves. Call your friends - this is a feast that will feed many!

programme.title: Pizzapalooza
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde is throwin’ down a pizza spread like never before with his Chicago-style tavern pie with sausage & onion, a grilled pizza pocket with pepperoni & cheese, chicken wings a la pizzaiola, and a zesty grilled caesar salad to finish it off.

programme.title: Deluxe Dogs with Crusted Corn & Potatoes
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde puts a modern spin on a classic All-American cookout with his loaded hot dogs, spiced smashed potato salad, chorizo & corn nut crusted corn, and bangin’ banana pudding pops. Sparklers out for this spread!

programme.title: Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consomme, and his an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, and giardiniera.

programme.title: Top of the Line Steaks
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde is back to level up his steak game by grilling up a NY strip steak with roasted onions & poblanos, short ribs with chili paste and horseradish, and a grilled chateaubriand with charred broccolini. Steak your claim on these dishes!

programme.title: Family-Friendly BBQ
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde creates a tasty menu that kids & parents alike will love! Apple pancakes with coconut brown butter syrup, grilled cheese & tomato soup, cheesy chicken parm, and a sticky s’mores dessert rounds out the full day of deliciousness.

programme.title: Grilled Chicken 3 Ways
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!

programme.title: Tempting Tasty Tacos
programme.desc: It’s always taco night at Chef Dale’s house! He turns up the heat with grilled salmon tacos with salsa verde & cauliflower escabeche, duck al pastor tacos with habanero pineapple salsa, & a smokey mushroom queso taco with truffle mole negro.

programme.title: The Perfection of Pork
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings the heat when it comes to making perfect pork dishes including a root beer glazed pork banh mi, chorizo fried rice, Filipino sausage stuffed long hot peppers, and round it all out with a spicy grilled pineapple sundae.

programme.title: A Festive & Flavorful Christmas in July
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde dons his Santa hat & holiday garb while grilling up smoked ham & pineapple praline sliders, sweet potatoes with soy maple bacon, eggplant with labneh & cranberries, a holiday mezze plate, and a grilled coquito cocktail.

programme.title: Heavenly Hibachi Bites
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde tries his hand at hibachi by making supreme fried rice with shrimp, chicken, and bacon, pretzel pork dumplings, mushroom noodles, a filet of beef with the famous onion volcano, and washes it down with a melon & mint sake slushy.

programme.title: Apocalypse Burgers

programme.desc: Ani, the most beautiful girl in the village, who is ever man's fantasy, decides to marry Mr. Bear as her husband, much to everyone's surprise. As for the chief village, he intend to organise the "wedding of the year".

programme.title: Menanti Hari Itu
programme.desc: Kisah kasih sayang seorang ibu terhadap anak kandungnya yang tidak pernah terpadam meskipun si anak menjauhkan diri akibat hasutan keluarga angkatnya sendiri.

programme.title: Kecundang Sebelum Menjanda
programme.desc: Hari terbahagia dalam hidup Nora berubah menjadi suram bila tunangnya menarik diri pada hari pernikahan mereka. Tambah buruk lagi, hari selepas tragedi itu asyik berulang atas sebab-sebab misteri.

programme.title: Aku Raja Lawak
programme.desc: Silah nak jadi pelawak yang terkenal, cuma di kampungnya tak ada peluang pekerjaan pelawak sepenuh masa. Tapi dia tetap mendapat sokongan padu daripada peminat nombor satunya – iaitu Faris, anaknya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan
programme.desc: Three best friends promised to get married, at the same time when they turn 26 years old. Their perceptions of marriage life begin to change and conflict ensues.

programme.title: Cik Puan Sinderella
programme.desc: This is a lighthearted family drama about a teenage girl who is closely guarded by her mother.

programme.title: Anak Kerak
programme.desc: Husin telah menggunakan ilmu hitam iaitu dengan ‘Anak Kerak' demi untuk mendapatkan kekebalan, kesenangan dan kemewahan hidup di dunia

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Buta
programme.desc: Telefilem komedi romantik tentang perkenalan singkat di antara Zulin, seorang gadis yang tidak pernah bercinta, dengan Izlan, seorang duda dalam satu 'blind date' yang diaturkan oleh Nadya Ramanshah.

programme.title: Matahari
programme.desc: Fauzi seorang guru yang telah dihantar untuk berkhidmat di Sabah. Di sana dia telah berkenalan dengan seorang novelis yang sedang mengalami masalah ‘writer’s block’ iaitu Yazid.

programme.title: Meniti Cinta Di Starimost
programme.desc: Iman dipaksa berkahwin dengan Qaseh, anak kepada orang gajinya untuk mewarisi harta bapanya. Percutian mereka di Bosnia membuahkan bibit-bibit cinta. Lakonan Iqram Dinzly, Zarina Zainoordin dan Yana Shamsudin.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Putus Cinta
programme.desc: Telemovie sekuel Jula Juli Bintang Cinta kini kembali! Kali ini, Jula dan Juli mengalami konflik percintaan dengan Dani & Izham sehingga mereka memutuskan untuk berpisah dan melarikan diri ke kampung Juli.

programme.title: Kampung Kuala Lambat
programme.desc: Kampung Kuala Lambat bagai mengalami sumpahan apabila lelaki yang berkahwin muda akan mati di hari pernikahan mereka namun kejadian ganjil ini tidak berlaku kepada lelaki yang berusia 60 tahun ke atas.

programme.title: Musnahkan Pelamin Anganku
programme.desc: Mikael yang merupakan seorang wedding planner menerima tawaran besar untuk menjayakan sebuah majlis perkahwinan pelanggannya. Namun majlis perkahwinan tersebut merupakan majlis bekas isterinya.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted…

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: At a house in Hull, Inspector Claire Little rescues two flea infested Staffordshire Bull Terriers named Roxy and Madison that are missing half of their fur. As Claire begins her investigation, will the scratching Staffies be able to recover?

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Samoyed dogs, known as "smiling angels" are in fact not easy to raise. They require enough love and dedication, especially extraordinary physical strength!!! For you to be happy and healthy with them.nIf you want to raise a Samoyed, or already own one, we hope you can give them the best care and love, and make them your best partners. Come and jot notes of the hard work and tears shared by expert owners :)!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Super eye-catching! Herbivorous animal celebrity appears?! Delicate pets being snubby! They get angry if there's no air conditioning?! Genius horse trainer challenges the rapport between human and horses?! Fresh grass is so sweet that even humans love to eat it?! Growing up with sheep! Experts reveal the secrets of sheep?!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Greyhound trainer John Thompson calls on Dr. Matt for help to get his lame star runner back on track. Matt removes a thorn from the greyhound's foot, but the pressure's on to get him fit enough for the next big race.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In this first episode Alan pulls on his apron and assists vet Gwen as she takes on the case of Staffordshire bull terrier Annie who has a suspected broken leg and a mystery lump.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner". While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you. However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her "experiences in ruling over dozens of cats", which is extremely precious. Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got stupid vs intelligent dogs, talented dogs, sporty dogs, pug life, dogs getting stuck, sleepy dogs, and dogs acting like humans.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. Parrots have a long lifespan and their IQ is comparable to that of a five-year-old child. How do you make them behave? Training is actually a good way, but how? "Melon seeds" are key to the goal. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss "Cute Pet Guide"!

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - A Song To Kill For
programme.desc: Max Mayfair has it all; a beautiful girlfriend, Ava, a new London crime family, and thanks to his latest heist, a priceless diamond necklace. However, when mafioso Calbone’s henchmen catch up with Mike and Armen, determined to drag them back to New York to pay for their crimes, Max has everything to lose. Teaming up with his old friend, Marseille Mafia crime boss, Paul, Max hatches a plan to lure the New York Mafia to Mayfair.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: No information available

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: No information available

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: A female FBI agent is offered millions to help a thief escape from a hijacked airplane.

programme.title: The Legion
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: High Voltage
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: A Las Vegas casino magnate, determined to find a new avenue for wagering, sets up a race for money.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Project Legion
programme.desc: A young man trapped in his apartment with a swarm of demons outside his door must find a way to survive the night and escape from apartment 213.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: High school teenagers accidentally unleash an ancient Irish entity on their hometown and must stop it before midnight on Halloween.

programme.title: Broken Star
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: During WWII, the American army have raced their way through the countryside on the border of France entering Nazi Germany. Hitler has deployed his secret weapon. Lieutenant Frank Ross encounters the Nazi weapon and an intense aerial battle ensues.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: Two dangerous armed men must hunt each other and fight to death over millions of dollars in cash in this high octane wilderness survival story.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: The utility of plants in regulating our environment is paramount but their aesthetics shouldn’t be underestimated. The notion that we first eat with our eyes extends to our relationship with plants.nnWeird and wonderful or just plain unassuming, plants seem set out to wit and to woo us, a giant frond waving our way, flowers that open only at 4 p.m. nnFurther testament to the uncanny nature of nature, the personalities of plant parents seem to mirror their plant children and vice versa – a plant otaku and his ground-defying airplants, an architect and his sublime flora sculptures.nnWhen bringing more wild into our environment, should we consider our personalities against the plant’s to better coexist? Don’t be afraid to go a little potty!

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. From their parents' very public split to being targeted by the press, they've been through quite a bit. Despite all this, they remain dedicated to supporting the monarchy with their charity work. Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E10 - Operation Crow Creek
programme.desc: 蒙大拿州的遊戲管理員正在偏遠地區尋找偷獵者，而其他管理員則處理更多非法狩獵和釣魚活動，並試圖阻止一名老人餵鹿。

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E09 - Head to Head
programme.desc: Con la tormenta ártica pisándoles los talones, los hermanos Keefer corren río abajo para llegar a su siguiente depósito de suministros, pero se pierden cuando el río se divide en un laberinto de pequeños canales.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E10 - Edge of the Storm
programme.desc: Cuando las temperaturas caen en picado, los hermanos Keefer se abren paso río abajo a través de aguas heladas y fuertes vientos en contra con la esperanza de llegar al lugar de extracción antes de que la tormenta ártica lo reclame.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E03 - Just-Terry-Fied
programme.desc: 特里和拉里對節目驗證進行了測試。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E04 - Terry's Reindeer Game
programme.desc: 特里和拉里測試馴鹿遊戲中班·阿弗萊克和查理茲·塞隆被困在冰凍湖底的場景，並通過水下用12口徑霰彈槍開三槍以打破冰面逃脫。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E01 - Astronauts
programme.desc: Cien kilómetros por encima de la superficie terrestre se encuentra una frontera invisible: el borde del espacio. Se trata de la Línea de Karman, el límite entre la atmósfera de nuestro planeta y lo que hay más allá. ¿Qué hace falta para cruzar esa línea?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E02 - Getting UpThere
programme.desc: Lanzar cargas útiles al espacio es una tarea muy difícil, históricamente los lanzamientos de cohetes son las proverbiales 'espadas en arados' Misiles diseñados para transportar cabezas atómicas ahora envían satélites y sondas al sistema solar. Irónicamente, es una de las pocas hazañas de la Humanidad que no se dan en la naturaleza.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: Desde salvadores de rinocerontes e investigadores de leones, hasta empresarios astutos y equipos de seguridad armados, Iván recorre la primera línea de la conservación para conocer a las personas que están remodelando y protegiendo el África salvaje. ¿Qué significa realmente dedicar la vida a la causa de la conservación? Ivan viaja a cuatro países distintos para averiguar qué mueve a estos héroes anónimos.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E18 - The Queen Mother An Affectionate Tribute
programme.desc: 皇太后，活得和世紀本身一樣長，是英國生活中備受喜愛的人物。她是二次世界大戰期間的勇氣象徵，是一種超越時間的穩定偶像，贏得了人們深厚的愛慕，這只是被女王自己所匹敵。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E06 - Pay Terry Back

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E03 - Orbit
programme.desc: La Estación Espacial Internacional es sin duda la joya de la corona de la órbita terrestre baja: puesto de observación, laboratorio de investigación y aula. Sin embargo, hay muchos otros activos en órbita alrededor de la Tierra que son aún más importantes para nuestra vida cotidiana: comunicaciones, observación meteorológica, posicionamiento global y gestión de recursos... la lista crece año tras año.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E04 - Shore to Shore
programme.desc: Nuestra naturaleza marinera se ha trasladado bien a la era espacial, tratando de navegar hacia lo desconocido en busca de riquezas de uno u otro tipo. Mientras Europa y Asia mantienen su interés por la Luna, rica en recursos, Estados Unidos y la NASA han puesto sus miras nada menos que en misiones tripuladas a Marte. ¿Serán capaces de ir de costa a costa en el más peligroso de los mares desconocidos, el espacio profundo?

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E07 - Sold into Slavery
programme.desc: Ivan está investigando el comercio ilegal de carne de caza en Kinshasa, cuando se topa con tres crías de chimpancé cautivas que se venden en el mercado negro. Se planea un dramático rescate en el que los chimpancés son entregados sanos y salvos a un lugar dedicado a proporcionar un futuro mejor a todos los primates de África.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E05 - Ex-Men The Origins of Terry
programme.desc: 特里和拉里測試X-Men起源的場景，試圖用武士刀劈開即將到來的AK-47子彈。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E06 - Pay Terry Back
programme.desc: 特里和拉里對梅爾·吉布森的電影《PAYBACK》進行測試。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E03 - Orbit
programme.desc: La Estación Espacial Internacional es sin duda la joya de la corona de la órbita terrestre baja: puesto de observación, laboratorio de investigación y aula. Sin embargo, hay muchos otros activos en órbita alrededor de la Tierra que son aún más importantes para nuestra vida cotidiana: comunicaciones, observación meteorológica, posicionamiento global y gestión de recursos... la lista crece año tras año.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E04 - Shore to Shore
programme.desc: Nuestra naturaleza marinera se ha trasladado bien a la era espacial, tratando de navegar hacia lo desconocido en busca de riquezas de uno u otro tipo. Mientras Europa y Asia mantienen su interés por la Luna, rica en recursos, Estados Unidos y la NASA han puesto sus miras nada menos que en misiones tripuladas a Marte. ¿Serán capaces de ir de costa a costa en el más peligroso de los mares desconocidos, el espacio profundo?

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E07 - Sold into Slavery
programme.desc: Ivan está investigando el comercio ilegal de carne de caza en Kinshasa, cuando se topa con tres crías de chimpancé cautivas que se venden en el mercado negro. Se planea un dramático rescate en el que los chimpancés son entregados sanos y salvos a un lugar dedicado a proporcionar un futuro mejor a todos los primates de África.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E25 - Kate The Making Of A Modern Queen
programme.desc: A look at the Duchess of Cambridge's journey from being an everyday young woman to becoming a future queen, and what her evolution signifies for the royal family.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince
programme.desc: 儘管所有媒體的喧囂，其中許多並不算水準，哈里依然是一個謎。這部引人入勝的紀錄片提供了新視角和鏡頭，來揭示一位面對心痛和丑聞的皇室王子的故事。

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E11 - Operation Whitefish
programme.desc: 守林人偶然發現令人震驚的犯罪現場，包括獵鹿者和一些非法釣魚活動。他們還向同事傑夫·達拉隊長道別，後者在服務26年後退休。

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E11 - After the Drop
programme.desc: Chris y Casey Keefer relatan sus momentos más memorables del viaje de este año a la cordillera Brooks de Alaska.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E12 - The Keefer Brothers
programme.desc: Los hermanos Keefer recuerdan uno de sus momentos favoritos de la aventura de este año.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E04 - Driving the Bus
programme.desc: Chris y Casey se inician en los sabores de la naturaleza neozelandesa y sufren un duro despertar. Los juegos mentales de la Madre Naturaleza empiezan a afectar a la fuerza mental de los hermanos, mientras su balsa hinchable sigue siendo un grave problema.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E05 - Round Two
programme.desc: Tensions run high as Chris and Casey disagree on what their next course of action should be. Without clear cache directions, the brothers are left with a hard choice. Should they stay, or should they go?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E06 - Peaks and Valleys
programme.desc: Chris y Casey caminan por la ladera de la montaña, pero las empinadas laderas y el esquisto movedizo hacen que la caminata no sea nada fácil. Los hermanos se enfrentan al agotamiento y la falta de energía, y sienten la presión de encontrar pronto nuevas fuentes de alimento o pasar hambre.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E07 - Day in the Life
programme.desc: La balsa sigue causando problemas mientras Chris y Casey gastan valiosas energías intentando mantenerse a flote. Con sus días en el Pacífico Sur menguando, los hermanos han llegado a su punto de ruptura'hasta que un nuevo descubrimiento deja un impacto duradero.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E08 - Bridge the Gap
programme.desc: Chris y Casey han atravesado Nueva Zelanda a pie durante semanas. Luchar por sus vidas ha hecho mella en sus emociones y habilidades. Se asocian para cazar jabalíes, pero los alijos utilizados para sobrevivir crean nuevos retos y profundas frustraciones.

programme.title: The Trail- S01:E03 - Relocation
programme.desc: Laramy se da cuenta de que la caza escasea debido a los lobos y decide poner distancia entre él y la manada. Es hora de levantar el campamento y trasladarse a un nuevo lugar.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E04 - White Death
programme.desc: La nieve, lo que los montañeses llamaban la muerte blanca, detiene a Laramy en su camino. Además, su fiel caballo 7 ha sufrido una herida en una pata. Laramy debe cuidar de Siete, luchar contra el hambre y sobrevivir a la nevada.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E05 - The Struggle
programme.desc: Laramy sigue atrapado en el Campamento Hell Hole, cuidando de la pierna de 7, y luchando por sobrevivir a las gélidas temperaturas sin comida.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E06 - On the Move
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete abandonan el campamento Hell Hole y emprenden de nuevo el camino. Se dirigen a una elevación más baja en busca de un lugar más permanente al que llamar hogar.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E07 - Permanent Residence
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete encuentran un lugar para acampar a largo plazo fuera de la nieve y a menor altitud. Laramy se pone manos a la obra para construir un refugio permanente y buscar comida.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E10 - Season Recap
programme.desc: Echamos un vistazo a las historias de supervivencia de la temporada con una mirada más profunda del ex soldado de las Fuerzas Especiales del Ejército, Terry Schappert.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E01 - After the Fall
programme.desc: El escalador Craig DeMartino se precipita 30 metros por un acantilado de granito. Convertido en un montón de huesos rotos, Craig se aferra a la vida. En una fracción de segundo, la vida de Craig se convierte en una inspiradora lucha por sobrevivir.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E02 - A River's Grasp
programme.desc: En un aislado río de montaña, el pescador Dean Ririe queda irremediablemente atrapado bajo una roca con el agua hasta el cuello. En aguas heladas que deberían matar a un hombre, Dean lucha por su vida a kilómetros de la ayuda.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E03 - ATV Nightmare
programme.desc: Una acampada de padre e hijo se convierte en una lucha desesperada por sobrevivir cuando John Sloot queda aplastado bajo un quad. Ahora su hijo de 10 años, Cody, debe enfrentarse solo a la naturaleza para conseguir ayuda.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E12 - Operation White Sulpher
programme.desc: Wardens are sorting through some hunters' conflicting tales, causing a guy to get in a bit of a jam. At the same time, other wardens are handling people trying to sneak onto properties as hunting season wraps up.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E01 - Into the Unknown
programme.desc: En el estreno de la temporada, los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer llegan a Nueva Zelanda sin prácticamente nada. Deben adaptarse rápidamente a su nuevo entorno o enfrentarse a consecuencias mortales.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E02 - White Water
programme.desc: La adrenalina se ha agotado para Chris y Casey, y el jet lag ha hecho acto de presencia. Los hermanos se enfrentan a temperaturas gélidas e impredecibles rápidos de aguas bravas. Cuando intentan navegar por las aguas bravas, su seguridad se ve amenazada.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E07 - Paint Your Red River Stagecoach at High Noon
programme.desc: 特里和拉里測試一些老西部電影的常見場景。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E08 - Terry's Underworld
programme.desc: 特里和拉里測試電影《地下世界》中的一個場景。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E05 - Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Mientras los últimos éxitos y fracasos se suceden, Marte sigue desvelando sus secretos. Nubes invisibles se revelan con luz ultravioleta y la búsqueda de la fuente de metano continúa con ExoMars. Mientras nos preparamos para el aterrizaje de los humanos en el planeta rojo, llegar es una cosa; permanecer a largo plazo es otra, ¿podemos realmente conquistar este planeta?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E06 - Emissaries
programme.desc: Our solar system is vast, from our own star the Sun to Earth is nearly 150 million kilometers or 1 Astronomical Unit. Jupiter is 5.2 AU distant and Pluto up to 48AU, the solar system extends far beyond this into interstellar space. We humans cannot yet travel that sort of distance, however w e can and do send our robots and probes in our place; and the results are astounding.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E08 - The Forgotten Giants
programme.desc: No toda la caza furtiva es por cuernos y colmillos. En muchas partes de África, asolada por la pobreza, las jirafas son asesinadas sin piedad por su carne. Ivan se une a un equipo especializado para explorar soluciones radicales que permitan a la vez salvar a la jirafa y proporcionar alimentos a las comunidades necesitadas.

programme.title: Diana: In Search of Happiness
programme.desc: 體驗對戴安娜公主的深入了解，這位20世紀的非凡女性。包含獨特的訪談和感人的片段，這幅肖像捕捉了她通往名聲的驚人之旅，以及她克服幾乎每天遭遇的情感和身體挑戰的能力。
